description.narrative:
With this money, Africans Rising will be able to fully implement its membership recruitment and engagement project within the Movement Growth Program byi. onboarding country volunteers and engagement personnel: These human resources will be in charge of the recruitment process namely outreach, registration ofmembers, orientation, political education and settling people into Action Groups.ii. having engagement platforms: Online platforms that will be used for constant, regular engagements. This will also entail provision of data allowance forfacilitatorsiii. improving multiple-language capabilities to ensure inclusivity: Paying for language translationand interpretation services for documents, in meetings andmember-member exchanges.The specific elements of the membership recruitment and engagement project are;1. Recruitment in parts of the continent where we have small numbers.As a Pan-African movement, it is important to ensure that our activities, mobilisation and organisation encompasses the whole continent. For the past few yearshowever, we have been lagging behind in terms of membership in North Africa and parts of the continent where Portuguese and Arabic are spoken. This grant willhelp us to specifically target and expand membership in these areas.2. Membership engagementAfricans Rising is rolling out a new movement engagement system. We are creating thematic Action Groups on our eight pillars - Climate Justice, Gender Justice,Civic Space expansion, Ethical Governance, Economic Justice, Reparations, Freedom of Movement, Anti-racism. These Action Groups will be the campaign hubs ofthe movement and platforms for constant, regular conversations on these issues as well as the interconnections among them.
By the end of this grant, we hope to have atleast 2000 members in each of the targeted countries totaling 20,000 members who will be connected with commonagenda on climate, gender, civic space, ethical governance, economic justice, reparations, free movement, anti-racism. This will be a step towards our completesystems approach to Pan-African organising and movement building
We hope to learn more about country contexts in these parts of Africa which due to language could sometimes seem cut off from the rest of the continent.Another learning point will be the approaches of recruitment that work in different cultural settings as well as what it means to bring people together to fightcommon causes.

participating-org.narrative: Africans Rising is a Pan-African movement of people and organisations, working for peace, justice, and dignity. Africans Rising looks to play a critical role on the continent pushing governments, business, and even established global and national NGOs to focus onchallenges African’s deem critical, including demands for a fair global trading system, concrete action to address the effects of climate change and the creation and strengthening of a representative coalition to protect our natural resources and the environment. Africans Rising has a specific focus on issues including: • Expanding space for civic and political action • Fighting for women’s rights and freedoms across society • Focusing on the right to equity and dignity • Ensuring good democratic and corruption-free governance • Promoting climate and environmental justice
